name: docintel_tools
description: Tools for grounded extraction over Indian corporate filings. Use FACTS for numbers and SEARCH for qualitative evidence; always cite company and page.

function.name: search_documents
function.description: Full-text search across extracted annual reports, quarterly results and investor presentations. Returns snippets with company, document id, type and page.

doc_id.description: Optional document id to scope the search.

function.name: get_financials
function.description: Return exact extracted financial fields with value, unit, period, reporting basis, source page and validation status. Never invent numbers; use this for numeric answers.

field_name.description: e.g. revenue, pat, ebitda, cfo, gnpa, casa

function.name: get_page
function.description: Return the full text and tables of one page for verification.

function.name: ask_documents
function.description: Ask a grounded question. Structured numbers are returned deterministically; qualitative answers use retrieved pages and the local LLM. Includes citations.

function.name: extract_pdf
function.description: Run the hybrid extractor on a local PDF path and add it to the searchable index.
